prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- choose_path: 80.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Adoption Preview & Trait Summary Screen: Insert a new adoption preview screen showing full 3D rendering and pet stats right before signing the adoption certificate. (why: Adoption step drops off significantly (68.9% conversion) and support emails report custom pet generation errors and visual confusion.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Pet Restoration Banner on Sign In: Display an explicit pet restoration hint and badge on the sign-in screen informing returning users that their existing desktop pets will sync immediately. (why: The largest volume of support tickets (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Render Status & Desktop Safety Guarantee: Add real-time render status information and desktop engine compatibility checks to the waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen has high mean wait time (2336s) and support emails show users experiencing issues where pets fail to open on desktop.)
3: [home, notification] Background Render Desktop Notification Prompt: Enable ready notifications on the waiting screen so users get desktop alerts when pet creation completes. (why: Home wait screen has a 2336s mean duration because users tab away and forget to return to complete setup.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Companion Identity Clarification Headline: Update choose_path copy to explicitly explain the difference between custom pet photo generation and pre-made companion selection. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating confusion between choice paths.)
